properties.displayName: User signed in from multiple countries within one hour
properties.description: Interactive successful sign-ins grouped per user per hour where more than one country was observed. VPN/roaming users will trip this - baseline them first.
properties.query:
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where ResultType == "0"
| summarize Signins = count(), Countries = make_set(Location), DistinctIPs = dcount(IPAddress) by UserPrincipalName, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| where array_length(Countries) > 1
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, Signins, Countries, DistinctIPs
